_comment: Org-published TTS models the scan finds but the benchmark does not evaluate, with the reason. Kept as a record so a rescan does not keep proposing them, and so the exclusions are arguable rather than invisible.

excluded.rifailabs/km-tts-v2: OmniVoice copy — k2-fsa/OmniVoice is the canonical one and is benchmarked
excluded.OpenVoiceOS/phoonnx-coqui-vits: a ~50-language grab-bag of Coqui voices; the Ghanaian-language tags are not backed by voices we could verify
excluded.multilingual-tts/F5-TTS-OpenBible-Twi-As: same weights as the ghananlpcommunity copy already benchmarked
excluded.multilingual-tts/F5-TTS-OpenBible-Twi-Ak: same weights as the ghananlpcommunity copy already benchmarked
excluded.multilingual-tts/F5-TTS-OpenBible-Ewe: same weights as the ghananlpcommunity copy already benchmarked
excluded.ghananlpcommunity/VoxCPM2-Ghana: evaluated and removed: 1.08-2.96 CER after correct inference
